query:
WITH ViolationsWithAge AS (
  SELECT 
    t.violator_id,
    t.gdate_happened,
    FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) AS age_at_violation,
    YEAR(t.gdate_happened) AS violation_year
  FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation t
  JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d 
    ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id
  WHERE t.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
    AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01'
    AND t.gdate_happened BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
),
Under25 AS (
  SELECT 
    violation_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS distinct_violators,
    COUNT(*) AS total_violations
  FROM ViolationsWithAge
  WHERE age_at_violation < 25 AND age_at_violation > 0
  GROUP BY violation_year
),
Over25 AS (
  SELECT 
    violation_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS distinct_violators,
    COUNT(*) AS total_violations
  FROM ViolationsWithAge
  WHERE age_at_violation > 25
  GROUP BY violation_year
)
SELECT 
  u.violation_year AS year,
  u.total_violations AS violations_under_25,
  o.total_violations AS violations_over_25,
  u.distinct_violators AS drivers_under_25,
  o.distinct_violators AS drivers_over_25,
  ROUND(u.total_violations * 1.0 / u.distinct_violators, 3) AS avg_violations_under_25,
  ROUND(o.total_violations * 1.0 / o.distinct_violators, 3) AS avg_violations_over_25,
  ROUND(((o.total_violations * 1.0 / o.distinct_violators) - (u.total_violations * 1.0 / u.distinct_violators)) * 100.0 / (u.total_violations * 1.0 / u.distinct_violators), 2) AS pct_difference
FROM Under25 u
JOIN Over25 o ON u.violation_year = o.violation_year
ORDER BY u.violation_year
LIMIT 100
